scope: Frozen local proxy opponents; full Python CLI at every atomic decision.

freeze.selection: E3 lost four games vs the authentic parent in 96 pairs. E2 and E4 tied the parent on all 72 subsequent paired outcomes; E2 is selected for its narrower conflict rule: preserve fresh replanning except a verified minion completion at end turn. No newly fitted route rule generalized to held-out source games.
freeze.promotion: Requires independent gain plus reliability. Selection is not promotion.
